findings.description: Григорий Захаров Кокоша died on 18 September 1846 in Zhydivska Hreblia, Tarashcha, Kiev; the death is recorded in the metric book of the church of St John the Theologian (Иоанно-Богословская церковь) there, which gives his birth as about 1821.

details.place: Zhydivska Hreblia, Tarashcha, Kiev, Russian Empire

supporting_sources: Ukraine, Kyiv, Orthodox Consistory Church Book Duplicates, 1723-1931 — death entry for Григорий Кокоша, 18 Sep 1846
